title: HP 15E Gulf Front Condo - Vacation Rental in High Pointe Resort,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents... "HP 15E Gulf Front Condo" at High Pointe Resort, located in Seacrest Beach. Start your mornings with breathtaking gulf views, take a dip in the stunning community pool, or enjoy exclusive access to the private beach. End your day with sunset cocktails and fresh seafood at Crabby Steve's, just a 1-minute walk from your door. This luxurious 2-suite condo sleeps 6 comfortably, making it perfect for families or friends looking to unwind. With endless opportunities to relax, explore, and indulge, this is the ultimate beach getaway. Ready to make it yours? Learn more below…*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Breathtaking Gulf-front views from the patio, Primary Suite, and living room – wake up to the soothing sound of waves and enjoy mesmerizing sunsets without leaving your space.Large community pool, hot tub, and private beach boardwalk just steps away – experience ultimate relaxation and effortless access to the pristine shoreline for a perfect beach getaway.Walking distance to Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and Peddlers Pavilion – immerse yourself in the charm of nearby coastal towns, boutique shops, and vibrant local spots within minutes.On-property dining at Crabby Steve's Beachside Grill – savor casual, delicious meals with stunning beachfront views, just a 1-minute walk from your stay.Sleeps 6 with carefully curated, family-friendly amenities – designed for comfort and convenience, ensuring everyone from kids to adults feels at home in this tranquil retreat.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"Absolutely breathtaking views! We loved every minute spent relaxing on the patio, listening to the soothing sound of the waves." – Michelle⭐"This condo had everything we could have hoped for to make our family getaway truly unforgettable. Highly recommend!" – Michael⭐"The location was absolutely perfect—steps from the beach and with an amazing lagoon pool that our whole family adored!" – Elizabeth*** LIVING AREA ***This open-concept layout radiates comfort and coastal elegance, offering a serene retreat by the sea. Unwind with loved ones in a thoughtfully designed space that boasts breathtaking Gulf views at every turn. A harmonious blend of chic, stylish furniture and cozy, inviting accents creates the perfect balance of luxury and practicality, ensuring a space that’s as beautiful as it is functional.Expansive living room with breathtaking Ocean viewsSmart TV loaded with family-favorites for endless entertainmentEffortless indoor-outdoor living with direct patio access designed for relaxation and enjoymentDining table for 4 and 2 sun loungers on the patio for ultimate comfort*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Create culinary masterpieces or quick, delicious snacks in the fully equipped kitchen, thoughtfully designed to blend convenience with style. Share unforgettable meals and cherished moments around the stunning dining table, perfect for bringing everyone together.Modern and updated, fully stocked kitchen featuring premium stainless steel appliancesSpacious dining table that comfortably seats 6 for memorable mealsComplete set of dinnerware, cookware, and glassware for all your culinary needs*** BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ***Unwind in two thoughtfully designed bedrooms that blend comfort and elegance. Both spaces offer premium bedding and easy access to updated bathrooms. Perfect for restful nights after sun-soaked days.Primary King Suite: King-size bed, Gulf views, private patio access, and flat-screen TV. En-suite bathroom with walk-in shower and dual vanity.Queen Guest Suite: Two Queen beds and flat-screen TV. Adjacent bathroom complete with shower/tub combo.*** HIGH POINTE RESORT OVERVIEW ***High Pointe Resort delivers everything you need for seaside serenity and luxurious living. You’re steps away from countless amenities that enhance the ultimate vacation experience.Exclusive Gulf Side Resort in a Gated Community in Seacrest BeachExpansive Pool Deck Featuring outdoor Pool, Serene Waterfall, Kiddie Pool, and Relaxing Hot TubBeach Front Bar and Grill – Crabby Steve’s, Serving Delicious Meals with Stunning Ocean ViewsExclusive Private Beach Boardwalk for Convenience and PrivacyAmenity-rich 15-Acre Tropical Paradise Perfect for Families and Beach EnthusiastsWell-Maintained Tennis Court and Four Pickleball Courts for Sports LoversChildren's Playground for the Little OnesShuffleboard Court for Family FunBBQ Grills - Charcoal for Outdoor Dining*** LOCATION AND COMMUNITY ***Perfectly located in Seacrest Beach, this condo is part of a tranquil, gated community while remaining within walking distance of everything you need. Enjoy easy access to award-winning restaurants, chic boutiques, and family activities.Peddlers Pavilion (Right Across the Street) – A lively gathering place, offering a diverse selection of vendors that appeal to both locals and tourists, complemented by live music on most summer evenings.Rosemary Beach (6 min walk) – Cobblestone streets, boutique shops, and a relaxed vibe.Alys Beach (0.9 mile) – Elegant architecture and serene atmosphere.Carillon Downtown & Market Street (8-minute drive) – a vibrant hub for shopping and dining.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Bicycle rentals are available for an additional fee and managed by La Dolce Vita.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest (including High Pointe), or Alys Beach.High Pointe HOA does not allow unregistered guests or visitors on-site.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY AND START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 210100
